title: MATERIALS AND MANUFACTURING PROCESSES
description: Introduces mechanical manufacturing methods by which materials are economically shaped into valuable products. Explores how the functionality, shape, materials, cost, and sustainability of a product influence manufacturing process selection and design.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: ENGR 321, 321H, MATS 321 or 321H.
A minimum grade of C is required in ENGR 321, ENGR 321H, MATS 321 and MATS 321H.
meeting_html: R 12pm-1:50pm in ROG 126 - Rogers Hall 126 (9/23 to 12/4)
